name: Unconfigured production page has no dashboard/demo/account bypass
Wrong password keeps the workspace locked
First login requires authenticator enrollment without operational requests
Invalid authenticator code is rejected and dashboard stays locked
Verified ID + TOTP enters admin dashboard and removes enrollment secret
Target marker and drone marker use independent coordinates
Accept saves status and does not turn suspect detection into confirmed identity
Event details show original JSON, target accuracy and drone snapshot
Archive is a separate route with search and filter controls
Tracking has GPS fields and geographic map, zero coordinate is valid
Geographic distance is labelled and computes reasonable metres
Stale telemetry disables command requests
New user flow provisions admin with a login ID
Expired review disables decisions without browser inventing a final status
Reject persists rejected state
Service failure freezes decisions and shows connection warning
Payload text is escaped rather than executed
Mobile layout has no document overflow
320px layout keeps the page inside viewport
Logout clears tokens, secret and private UI; hash cannot restore session
Subsequent login challenges existing factor without reenrollment
Page refresh does not restore a cached authenticated session
No browser requests to Supabase Auth or database
No uncaught browser errors
